{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace BucketAgg

inductive FillMode where
  | none
  | previous

def valid (start end width : Nat) : Prop :=
  start ≤ end ∧ width > 0

/-- Reference implementation: aggregates events into time buckets per group. -/
def solve (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
          (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) : List (String × Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
  let inRange (t : Nat) : Bool := t ≥ start ∧ t < end
  let bucketOf (t : Nat) : Nat := start + (t - start) / width * width
  let groups : List String :=
    (List.map (fun e => e.1) events).distinct
  let sortedGroups : List String := List.sort groups
  let bucketStarts : List Nat :=
    List.range ((end - start + width - 1) / width)
      |>.map (fun i => start + i * width)
  let results : List (String × Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.flatMap (fun g =>
      let gEvents : List (Nat × Option Nat) :=
        List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g then some (e.2, e.3) else none) events
      let bucketResults : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
        List.map (fun bs =>
          let inBucket : List (Option Nat) :=
            List.filterMap (fun (t, v) => if inRange t ∧ t ≥ bs ∧ t < bs + width then some v else none) gEvents
          let nonNull : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun v => v) inBucket
          let cnt : Nat := nonNull.length
          let sum : Nat := List.sum nonNull
          let val : Option Nat :=
            if cnt > 0 then some sum
            else if fill = FillMode.none then none
            else
              let prevBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
                List.takeWhile (fun (_, _, v) => v = none) (List.reverse (List.takeWhile (fun (_, _, v) => v = none) (List.reverse (List.map (fun bs' =>
                  let inB : List (Option Nat) := List.filterMap (fun (t, v) => if inRange t ∧ t ≥ bs' ∧ t < bs' + width then some v else none) gEvents
                  let nn : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun v => v) inB
                  let c : Nat := nn.length
                  let s : Nat := List.sum nn
                  (bs', c, if c > 0 then some s else none) bucketStarts))))
              let lastNonEmpty : Option (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
                List.findSome? (fun (_, _, v) => v) (List.reverse (List.map (fun bs' =>
                  let inB : List (Option Nat) := List.filterMap (fun (t, v) => if inRange t ∧ t ≥ bs' ∧ t < bs' + width then some v else none) gEvents
                  let nn : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun v => v) inB
                  let c : Nat := nn.length
                  let s : Nat := List.sum nn
                  (bs', c, if c > 0 then some s else none) bucketStarts)))
              match lastNonEmpty with
              | some (_, _, v) => v
              | none => none
          (bs, cnt, val)
        ) bucketStarts
      List.map (fun (bs, cnt, val) => (g, bs, cnt, val)) bucketResults
    ) sortedGroups
  results

/-- O1: Output contains all unique groups sorted lexicographically. -/
theorem thm_O1 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
              (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let outGroups : List String := List.map (fun r => r.1) out
  let inGroups : List String := (List.map (fun e => e.1) events).distinct
  List.sort inGroups = outGroups := by sorry

/-- O2: Bucket start times are start, start+width, ... strictly below end. -/
theorem thm_O2 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let gBuckets : List Nat := List.map (fun r => r.2) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  let expected : List Nat := List.range ((end - start + width - 1) / width) |>.map (fun i => start + i * width)
  gBuckets = expected := by sorry

/-- O3: Bucket interval coverage. -/
theorem thm_O3 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (t : Nat) (v : Option Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  inRange (t) → (∃ bs cnt val, (bs, cnt, val) ∈ gBuckets ∧ bs ≤ t ∧ t < min (bs + width) end) ↔
  (∃ bs cnt val, (bs, cnt, val) ∈ gBuckets ∧ bs ≤ t ∧ t < bs + width ∧ bs < end) := by sorry

/-- O4: Count is number of non-null in-range values. -/
theorem thm_O4 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs, _, _) ∈ gBuckets →
  let cnt := (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2 ≥ bs ∧ r.2 < bs + width ∧ r.2 ≥ start ∧ r.2 < end) events).length
  let nonNullCnt := (List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events).length
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.2 = nonNullCnt := by sorry

/-- O5: Value is sum of non-null values when count > 0. -/
theorem thm_O5 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs, _, _) ∈ gBuckets →
  let nonNullVals : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  let cnt := nonNullVals.length
  let sum := List.sum nonNullVals
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.3 = if cnt > 0 then some sum else (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.3 := by sorry

/-- O6: Fill none gives null for empty buckets. -/
theorem thm_O6 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width FillMode.none
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs, _, _) ∈ gBuckets →
  let nonNullVals : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  nonNullVals.length = 0 →
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.3 = none := by sorry

/-- O7: Fill previous gives latest previous nonempty sum or null. -/
theorem thm_O7 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width FillMode.previous
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs, _, _) ∈ gBuckets →
  let nonNullVals : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  nonNullVals.length = 0 →
  let prevBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.filter (fun (b, c, v) => b < bs ∧ c > 0) gBuckets
  let lastPrev : Option (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.findSome? (fun (_, _, v) => v) (List.reverse prevBuckets)
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.3 =
    match lastPrev with
    | some (_, _, v) => v
    | none => none := by sorry

/-- O8: Empty buckets never reset previous value. -/
theorem thm_O8 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs1 bs2 : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width FillMode.previous
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs1, _, _) ∈ gBuckets → (bs2, _, _) ∈ gBuckets → bs1 < bs2 →
  let nonNull1 : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs1 ∧ e.2 < bs1 + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  let nonNull2 : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs2 ∧ e.2 < bs2 + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  nonNull1.length = 0 → nonNull2.length = 0 →
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs2) gBuckets).getD!.3 =
    (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs1) gBuckets).getD!.3 := by sorry

/-- O9: Events before start never seed previous value. -/
theorem thm_O9 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
              (start end width : Nat)
              (h : valid start end width)
              (g : String) (bs : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width FillMode.previous
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs, _, _) ∈ gBuckets →
  let beforeStart : List (Option Nat) :=
    List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 < start then e.3 else none) events
  let nonNullBefore : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun v => v) beforeStart
  let nonNullInBucket : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  nonNullInBucket.length = 0 →
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.3 =
    (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) (List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) (solve (List.filter (fun e => e.2 ≥ start) events) start end width FillMode.previous)))).getD!.3 := by sorry

/-- O10: Output ordered by group then bucket start. -/
theorem thm_O10 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
               (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
               (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  List.SortedOn (fun r => (r.1, r.2)) out := by sorry

/-- O11: Zero sum is a valid previous value. -/
theorem thm_O11 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
               (start end width : Nat)
               (h : valid start end width)
               (g : String) (bs1 bs2 : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width FillMode.previous
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  (bs1, _, _) ∈ gBuckets → (bs2, _, _) ∈ gBuckets → bs1 < bs2 →
  let nonNull1 : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs1 ∧ e.2 < bs1 + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  let nonNull2 : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs2 ∧ e.2 < bs2 + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  nonNull1.length > 0 → List.sum nonNull1 = 0 → nonNull2.length = 0 →
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs2) gBuckets).getD!.3 = some 0 := by sorry

/-- O12: Duplicate events are counted. -/
theorem thm_O12 (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
               (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode)
               (h : valid start end width)
               (g : String) (t : Nat) (v : Option Nat) (n : Nat) :
  let out := solve events start end width fill
  let gBuckets : List (Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.map (fun r => (r.2, r.3, r.4)) (List.filter (fun r => r.1 = g) out)
  let bs := start + (t - start) / width * width
  t ≥ start → t < end →
  (List.count (fun e => e = (g, t, v)) events) = n →
  let nonNullVals : List Nat := List.filterMap (fun e => if e.1 = g ∧ e.2 ≥ bs ∧ e.2 < bs + width ∧ e.2 ≥ start ∧ e.2 < end then e.3 else none) events
  (List.find (fun r => r.1 = bs) gBuckets).getD!.2 = nonNullVals.length := by sorry

/-- Non-vacuity: valid success and error cases exist. -/
theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat)) (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode),
    valid start end width ∧
    (List.map (fun r => r.1) (solve events start end width fill)).length > 0 ∧
    ∃ (events2 : List (String × Nat × Option Nat)) (start2 end2 width2 : Nat) (fill2 : FillMode),
      valid start2 end2 width2 ∧
      (List.map (fun r => r.1) (solve events2 start2 end2 width2 fill2)).length = 0 := by sorry
